metadata.title: Asymptotics for the number of saddle connections on a slit torus
metadata.abstract: We consider a flat torus with a marked line segment $\beta$ and prove linear asymptotics for closed curves on the torus disjoint from the interior of the line segment. We also consider segments that begin and terminate at the end points of $\beta$ whose interiors are disjoint from $\beta$ and prove $L\log L$ asymptotics. In all cases, after quotienting by the growth rate, we compute the constant explicitly, which differs depending on whether or not $\beta$ lies in a periodic direction on the torus. In particular, when $\beta$ lies along a non-periodic trajectory, we show the constant is $2/(|\beta| \zeta(2))$. Moreover, we prove that as a function of the holonomy vector of $\beta$, the constants are continuous at the points where $\beta$ lies in a non-periodic direction.

analysis.topic: 几何拓扑、低维流形与结
analysis.workSummary: 对带标记裂缝的平坦环面，计算避开裂缝内部的闭曲线线性渐近及端点连接线段的 L log L 渐近，并给出周期与非周期方向的显式常数。
analysis.breakthrough: 不仅确定增长阶，还得到非周期方向常数及相应连续性。
analysis.limitations: 结论针对裂缝环面及指定避交条件，不能直接推广到高亏格平移曲面。 当前数学解读依据摘要，尚未逐步审读证明。
analysis.aiEvidence: 作者披露 Microsoft Copilot 生成全部 TikZ 图，并明确未用于其他内容，包括数学内容。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。作者披露 Microsoft Copilot 生成全部 TikZ 图，并明确未用于其他内容，包括数学内容。

analysis.priorityReason: 适合平坦曲面测地计数，实例具体且常数可验证。
